correctness.rationale: The odd-order generalized-dihedral homomorphism normal form and composition are established exhaustively; all compatible affine projections share a fixed point, and translation choices have exact quotient cardinality. Simultaneous Boolean idempotent splitting for abelian groups, exact stabilizer ratios and the indecomposable refinement of maximal cliques prove all formulas. The mixed-exponent specialization was algebraically rederived and a direct finite-group checker reproduced the C9 plus C3 numbers, including actual group composition. No infinite result relies on finite tests.
